name: Mader detonation
blurb: The Mader problem (ExactPack’s mader; Timmes et al. 2005): a 5 cm slab of explosive (gamma = 3, density 1.875 g/cm^3) detonated from a wall at rest at x = -2.5, the detonation running at its Chapman–Jouguet speed of 0.8 cm/us. Behind it a Taylor wave brings the products to rest half way back to the wall. Lengths in cm and times in microseconds. The run starts from the exact solution at 0.25 us and ends at 6 us, with the detonation 0.2 cm from the far end.
